Baked before the town wakes up

Hollin & Pike is a family bakery on Wetherstone high street. Our ovens go on at four, so the bread on the shelf is never more than a few hours old.

Slow bread, done properly

Every sourdough is fermented for thirty-six hours with flour milled twenty miles away. No improvers, no shortcuts.
